voiceover: Here's a trick to know how fast money doubles, in your head. Take seventy-two and divide it by the yearly return. Six percent? Seventy-two divided by six is twelve. Your money doubles in about twelve years. Nine percent? About eight years. It works on debt too. A card at twenty-four percent doubles what you owe in about three years if you never pay it. That's the rule of seventy-two. It's an estimate, but it's close. Comment CASH and I'll send you the calculator for the exact number.
